'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2014–present)|Yemeni Civil War]]
**[[2020 Aden attacks]]
***At least 25 people are killed and more than 110 others wounded in an attack at the [[Aden International Airport]], shortly after a plane carrying the newly formed [[government of Yemen|government]] arrived from [[Saudi Arabia]]. [[Prime Minister of Yemen|Prime Minister]] [[Maeen Abdulmalik Saeed]] is taken to safety along with the Saudi [[ambassador]] and all remaining government members. The [[Houthis]] are blamed for the attack, but the group has denied responsibility. Another blast was later reported at the presidential palace, where the cabinet was meeting. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/blast-at-yemens-aden-airport-as-new-cabinet-members-land/2020/12/30/f29d6a1e-4a91-11eb-97b6-4eb9f72ff46b_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Syria]]n [[state media]] reports that an [[ambush]] on a bus near [[Palmyra]] killed at least 37 people. A senior [[Syrian Armed Forces|military]] [[defector]] in the region says that the bus was transporting [[Syrian Army]] [[troop]]s and pro-[[government of Syria|government]] [[militia]] from [[Deir ez-Zor]] to the [[Tiyas Military Airbase]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-crisis-attack/syrian-state-media-says-28-killed-in-a-bus-ambush-in-deir-al-zor-idUSKBN2941ZI?il=0 (Reuters)] [https://www.syriahr.com/en/198297/ (SOHR)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2020 Gjerdrum landslide]]
**A [[landslide]] in the village of [[Gjerdrum]], [[Viken (county)|Viken]], [[Norway]], leaves at least ten people injured and buries several houses. Ten people are missing. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-55484627 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
*****[[California]] reports its first case of [[Variant of Concern 202012/01|a more contagious variant of SARS-CoV-2]] from the [[United Kingdom]] in a patient from [[Southern California]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/virus-surge-swamping-hospitals-prompts-indefinite-lockdown-74963434 (ABC News)]
*****California reports a record 442 deaths on Tuesday, bringing the statewide death toll to 24,987. [https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/532064-california-sets-new-coronavirus-daily-death-record-with-442 (''The Hill'')]
*****[[Los Angeles County, California|Los Angeles County]] surpasses 10,000 deaths from COVID-19 and is averaging 150 daily deaths. [https://abc7.com/covid-deaths-covid-19-coronavirus-los-angeles/9208467/ (KABC-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Alabama]]
*****Outgoing [[United States Senate|U.S. Senator]] [[Doug Jones (politician)|Doug Jones]] of [[Alabama]] announces he will quarantine at his home after his wife tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.al.com/news/2020/12/alabama-sen-doug-jones-to-quarantine-after-louise-jones-tests-positive-for-covid-19.html (AL.com)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Colorado]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[Colorado]] authorities announce the possible discovery of a second case of the SARS-CoV-2 variant from the [[United Kingdom]] in the state. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/12/30/health/colorado-uk-coronavirus-variant/index.html (CNN)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in North Dakota]]
*****[[North Dakota]] records 96 hospitalizations in the past 24 hours, making it the first time since September 24 that there have been less than 100 hospitalizations in the state. [https://apnews.com/article/health-north-dakota-coronavirus-pandemic-5e00beb35101df60df53ae41cd2164f5 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Toronto]]
******[[Toronto]] reports a record of 1,069 cases in the past 24 hours. [https://globalnews.ca/news/7547375/toronto-daily-coronavirus-cases-over-1000/ (Global News)]
*****[[Ontario]] reports a record 2,923 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the total number of confirmed cases in the province to 178,831. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/doses-moderna-covid-19-vaccine-expected-arrive-ontario-today-1.5857207 (CBC)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in El Salvador]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[El Salvador]] approves [[AZD1222|a vaccine]] made by the [[University of Oxford]] and [[AstraZeneca]] for use in the country. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-el-salvador-vaccine/el-salvador-greenlights-astrazeneca-oxford-university-covid-19-vaccine-idUSE1N2BP02J (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Scotland]]
*****[[Scotland]] reports a record 2,045 new cases in the past 24 hours. [https://www.heraldscotland.com/news/18976898.coronavirus-scotland-new-surge-covid-19-cases-one-in-ten-tests-positive/ (''The Herald'')]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination programme in the United Kingdom]]
*****The [[United Kingdom]] approves [[AZD1222|a vaccine]] made by the [[University of Oxford]] and [[AstraZeneca]] for use in the country. [[Secretary of State for Health and Social Care|Health Secretary]] [[Matt Hancock]] says that the rollout of this vaccine will begin on January 4. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/health-55280671 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Czech Republic]]
****The [[Czech Republic]] reports a record 16,329 new cases in the past 24 hours as the positivity rate reaches a new record of 48.5%. [https://english.radio.cz/covid-19-risk-highest-level-record-number-cases-positive-tests-tuesday-8704113 (Radio Prague International)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] reports a record 1,129 deaths in the past 24 hours, according to data from the [[Robert Koch Institute]], marking the first time that the country has surpassed 1,000 daily deaths since the beginning of the pandemic. [https://www.dw.com/en/coronavirus-german-daily-death-toll-surpasses-1000-for-1st-time/a-56090689 (DW)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]]
****[[Taoiseach]] [[Micheál Martin]] confirms that the [[Republic of Ireland|country]] will close all non-essential retail under full level 5 restrictions that will remain in place for at least one month and will also delay the reopening of schools until January 11. Authorities also agree to extend travel bans to [[South Africa]] and the [[United Kingdom]] until January 6. [https://www.rte.ie/news/2020/1230/1186931-cabinet-meeting/ (RTÉ)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malta]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Malta]] reports its first three cases of a new variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] from the [[United Kingdom]]. Two of the cases are reported in people who travelled from the UK, while the third is still being investigated. [https://timesofmalta.com/articles/view/uk-covid-19-variant-detected-in-malta.841925 (''Times of Malta'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] receives their first shipment of three million doses of [[Sinovac Biotech|Sinovac]]'s [[CoronaVac]]. [https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/first-batch-of-covid-19-vaccines-arrives-in-turkey-161250 (''Hurriyet Daily News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] signs an agreement to buy up to 1.8 million doses of [[Sinovac Biotech|Sinovac]]'s [[CoronaVac]]. Prime Minister [[Denys Shmyhal]] says the first shipment of vaccines could arrive in February. [https://www.businesstimes.com.sg/government-economy/ukraine-signs-up-for-chinas-sinovac-vaccine-with-doses-expected-soon (''Business Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Taiwan]] reports its first case of a new variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] after a teenager who returned from the [[United Kingdom]] on Sunday tested positive for [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] the following day. [https://focustaiwan.tw/society/202012300008 (Focus Taiwan News Channel)]
****As a result of this case, Taiwan will ban all non-resident foreigners from entering the country beginning on January 1. Legal residents, as well as people given special permission, and the spouses and children of [[Taiwanese people|Taiwanese]] nationals will be excluded from this ban. [https://en.rti.org.tw/news/view/id/2004582 (Radio Taiwan International)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[India]] extends their suspensions of flights from the [[United Kingdom]] until January 7 in order to prevent the spread of a new variant of [[SARS-CoV-2]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/india-extends-uk-flight-ban-till-jan-7-will-impose-restrictions-thereafter/story-B2RAgn088nwtMCdTQu5NyO.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]]
****[[Singapore]] officially begins its [[vaccination]] campaign against COVID-19, with healthcare workers being among the first to receive the [[Pfizer]]-[[BioNTech]] vaccine [[tozinameran]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/singapore/covid-19-first-vaccinations-ncid-healthcare-workers-pfizer-13864346 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] imposes a ban on large gatherings and events in controlled zones across the country in order to reduce the number of cases. 250 new cases are reported in the past 24 hours. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2043475/tiered-bans-on-gatherings-imposed-nationwide-over-covid (''Bangkok Post'')] [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/thailand-covid-19-new-year-gatherings-banned-control-outbreak-13866734 (CNA)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
****[[Argentina]] approves [[AZD1222|a vaccine]] made by the [[University of Oxford]] and [[AstraZeneca]] for use in the country, becoming the second country after the UK to approve this vaccine. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20201230-argentina-approves-astrazeneca-oxford-covid-vaccine (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bolivia]]
****[[Bolivia]] signs a deal with [[Russia]]'s [[Russian Direct Investment Fund]] to secure 2.6 million [[Sputnik V]] vaccines. [https://sputnikvaccine.com/newsroom/pressreleases/rdif-to-supply-2-6-million-doses-of-russian-sputnik-v-coronavirus-vaccine-to-bolivia/ (Sputnik V)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Zambia]], [[501.V2 variant]]
***[[Ministry of Health (Zambia)|Health Minister]] [[Chitalu Chilufya]] confirms [[Zambia]]'s first case of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 from [[South Africa]] and also confirms that a second wave of the pandemic has emerged. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-12/30/c_139630370.htm (Xinhua)]

'''International relations'''
*[[United States–European Union relations]], [[First Trump tariffs|Trump tariffs]]
**The United States announces plans to impose additional [[tariff]]s on certain products from France and Germany, particularly [[aircraft part]]s, in [[First Trump tariffs|retaliation]] to tariffs imposed by the [[European Union]] on similar U.S. products this year. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/united-states/us-slaps-tariffs-on-french-and-german-wines-aircraft-parts-amid-eu-dispute (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')] 

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Abortion in Argentina]]
**[[Voluntary Interruption of Pregnancy Bill (Argentina)|Voluntary Interruption of Pregnancy Bill]]
***Argentina legalizes [[abortion]] by a Senate vote of 38 to 29, with one abstention. President [[Alberto Fernández]] has indicated that he will sign the bill into law. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/12/30/world/americas/argentina-legalizes-abortion.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Islam in Indonesia]]
**[[Indonesia]] bans any activities held by the [[Islamic Defenders Front]], a hardline Islamic group led by the controversial cleric [[Muhammad Rizieq Shihab]]. The [[Coordinating Ministry for Political, Legal, and Security Affairs (Indonesia)|Coordinating Political, Legal, and Security Minister]] [[Mahfud MD]] says the ban is necessary because the group no longer has any legal standing as a [[mass organisation]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/indonesia-bans-hardline-islamic-defenders-front-group (''The Straits Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Trade negotiation between the UK and the EU]]
**The [[United Kingdom]]'s [[House of Commons of the United Kingdom|House of Commons]] approves the [[EU–UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement]] with the [[European Union]] by 521 votes to 73. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-55478513 (BBC News)]
**[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] formally signs the agreement into law. [https://news.sky.com/story/brexit-mps-overwhelmingly-back-eu-uk-trade-deal-ahead-of-end-of-transition-period-12175646 (Sky News)]
*[[2021 Ugandan general election]]
**[[Bobi Wine]], challenger to the incumbent [[President of Uganda|President]] [[Yoweri Museveni]] who has been in office since 1986, is arrested along with his entire campaign team in the town of [[Kalangala]]. No information about the arrest has been made available. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/bobi-wine-ugandan-presidential-challenger-and-team-arrested/ar-BB1cmfov (CNN via MSN)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[2020 in paleontology]]
**Scientists at the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] announce the discovery of a "well-preserved" [[woolly rhinoceros]] carcass in [[Abyysky District]], [[Sakha Republic|Sakha]], [[Russia]], which was revealed by melting permafrost in August. The Russian Academy of Sciences says that the woolly rhinoceros was likely 3 or 4 years old when it died by drowning in the river, and could be anywhere from 20,000 to 50,000 years old. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/preserved-ice-age-woolly-rhino-found-siberia-74973072?cid=clicksource_4380645_2_heads_hero_live_headlines_hed  (ABC News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2020–21 Premier League]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]]
**A proposed match between [[Tottenham Hotspur]] and [[Fulham F.C.]] at [[Tottenham Hotspur Stadium]] that would have taken place in the evening is postponed due to a significant rise of COVID-19 cases in the clubs across the league. [https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11661/12174960/tottenham-vs-fulham-premier-league-match-postponed-due-to-covid-19-cases-at-west-london-club (Sky Sports)]
